Pattern: • Ch 21 • 20 sc in back bumps • Work in BLO for 16 rows • Always keep 20 sc • Fold in half • Join sides with 10 sc • Use reserved yarn to join other side • Handle: ch 45 • Sc back across handle chain • Decorate however you want ✨ Made with @clowex_official  t-shirt yarn and an 8 mm hook.
